delivered_contracts: Fallible GP history operations retain a typed SimulationError::Allocation, allocator source, stable allocation_failed code, and nonretryable resource classification through capture and restore.

Delay-buffer sizing explicitly projects ordinary samples, event sides, known derivative-order records, spare capacity and compact copies; tests compare predictions to backing capacity after wrap/prune/copy.
The native GP exact-delay record quota defaults to 256 MiB and aggregates all engine-owned live histories and retained checkpoint copies.
Initialization, accepted growth, physical startup, periodic boundary copy preparation, scheduled/final capture and restoration preflight the appropriate simultaneously owned record buffers.
Public resource tests cover multiple devices, OP/UIC, zero phase, Weil without exact-delay records, waveform-only/compressed output, retained scheduled copies and stricter resume budgets.
Fault injection targets actual final capture after counting startup copies; failed capture/restore preserves typed errors, input checkpoints and repeatable subsequent execution.
Resource refusals before growth/startup commit preserve all accepted participants; zero-budget restoration refuses before the first injected copy allocation.
Materialization uses a shared checked coordinate lookup and borrows when an owned coordinate is not required.

included: Native GP exact-delay backing records including spare capacity
Simultaneously live engine-owned transport histories and retained checkpoint copies
